description: Delete a key (auth key, API access token, OAuth client, or federated identity). This is irreversible. For auth keys, devices already authenticated are unaffected but no new devices can use it. For OAuth clients and federated identities, any integrations using them lose access immediately. API access tokens are deletable here too: if keyId is the token this server authenticates with -- it shows up in tailscale_list_keys under API-key auth -- the server revokes its own credential and every later call fails with 401 until it is reconfigured.

keyId.description: The key ID to delete (auth key, API access token, OAuth client, or federated identity)

name: tailscale_delete_key
title: Delete key
